name: asset-l10-dispersal-tank-bullet
note: L10 twin horizontal pressure vessels with catwalk bridge, courier for scale. Look for: saddles reach the ground, catwalk railings closed, manifold and outlet on the ground. The game camera never zooms out past 1.0 (about 20 m across): pieces taller or wider than that are seen in part, which is the intended monumental read.
